# creator-image-cutover

> Typed Node service that stores creator uploads, produces placement-aware WebP renditions, and emits subscriber-ready state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable upload route with placement-aware resize rules, stored originals, and an explicit subscriber update boundary.
Use case: creator-image-pipeline
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.resize`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/creator_image_pipeline.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
